title: Ex-Governor of Guerrero Ángel Aguirre Arrested; Accused of Hiding Evidence on the 43 of Ayotzinapa
author: Gustavo Castillo García
content:
_This article by Gustavo Castillo García originally appeared in the[August 6,
2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/08/06/politica/detiene-al-ex-
gobernador-de-guerrero-angel-heladio-aguirre-lo-senalan-de-ocultar-evidencia-
sobre-los-43-de-ayotzinapa), Mexico’s premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City.** The Attorney General's Office (FGR) arrested the former
governor of Guerrero, Ángel Heladio Aguirre Rivero, as the party **allegedly
responsible for concealing evidence in the disappearance of the 43 students
from the Ayotzinapa teachers ' college.**

The federal Public Prosecutor's Office announced that the former Guerrero
official (2011–2014) was apprehended **“as part of the new investigation
model, and the reanalysis of the existing proceedings in the case of the
disappearance of 43 students from the Raúl Isidro Burgos rural teachers '
college of Ayotzinapa, Guerrero, which involved new investigative actions that
made it possible to establish the possible participation of Ángel ‘N,’ former
governor of that state, in the concealment of evidence to determine the
whereabouts of the students.”**

The FGR requested, obtained, and executed the arrest warrant against him.
